title: 🔴 Daemon restart spawns duplicate ticks — cleanDanglingOnStartup marks live gateway sessions timeout. tick_process.go:178-200 blanket-UPDATEs ALL running ticks to status='timeout' on startup (exec-fallback assumption: children died with daemon). With --no-exec-fallback + gateway HTTP spawns, sessions SURVIVE the restart — proven live 2026-08-01 tick #190: my own tick (coding-hermes-scheduler-20-24-50) was marked timeout while still executing; 6 fresh spawns at 20:28:02 duplicated in-flight work for scheduler/helix/canopy/dexdat (helix already had 2 running ticks pre-restart). Also the last_tick_completed=now UPDATE (line 184-188) makes the packer treat live projects as just-completed. FIX DIRECTION: only clean ticks with pid>0 whose /proc/<pid> is gone (exec children — reapZombies already does this); leave pid=0 gateway ticks 'running' — CleanupStale(maxAge) in lifecycle.go:136 clears true zombies within the stale window. Regression test: restart loop with an in-flight pid=0 tick must NOT respawn that project while the record is running.
